Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after a badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo said at 10:44 that six trucks were waiting at the east gate.

Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, and the guard checked in trailer 8836 on it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes had been working since 11:07. That makes the clipboard period about 25 minutes.
